_about: Reference annotations for the running-display videos (pump-live/video-*.mp4): one frame per video annotated by hand, the quads tracked into every frame by pump_reader.track --videos, the total and liters of each frame read by the reader and kept only when total == round(liters x price) (PumpVideoReadTests), the price a constant. The per-frame texts live in video-labels.json; the product owner corrects them in the annotator's Frames view.
